name: Wrathful Smite

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

summary: Right after a melee hit: an extra 1d6 Necrotic, and a Wis save or the target is Frightened for up to 1 minute.
text: Bonus Action, cast right after you hit a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike. The target takes an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage from the attack and makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure it has the Frightened condition until the spell ends; at the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success. Lasts 1 minute (no Concentration). Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.
